title: vaultMethod
responsibility: Selects the Credential Vault method for a site action: API token, then OAuth device grant, then browser login.

inputs.name: vaultMethod.readiness
inputs.description: For each method kind, true when it can run now or a reason it cannot; a missing kind is not ready.

outputs.name: vaultMethodOrder
outputs.description: The fixed preference order: api-token, oauth-device, browser.

outputs.name: vaultMethod
outputs.description: The selected method, a block naming the preferred method and why it is not ready, or unsupported when no method covers the action.
